node.title: Compromisos concurrentes de capacidad humana
node.summary: Obligations can compete for the time and skills of the same people.

relations: A scheduling design should distinguish aggregate available hours from a feasible assignment that respects deadlines, competence and precedence.
Es una aplicación propuesta de 2026; no se afirma que el mandato HR utilizara HC-HID ni completara el rollout.
